2027 Plan and Budget Gift Card Prize Draws: Contest Rules and Regulations

This contest is open to anyone during the contest period. The Contest commences on September
14, 2026 and closes at 11:59 pm. (E.T.) on Friday, February 26, 2027.

Entry:
1. Complete our survey or quiz for one chance to enter a draw for a $25 gift card for your choice of either
    Tim Horton's, President's Choice, Sobey’s, Shoppers Drug Mart or Canadian Tire.
   At the end of the survey or quiz you will be given a chance to enter the draw.
2. You must have an e-mail address to enter the Contest.
3. The Contest commences on September 14, 2026 and closes at 11:59 pm. (E.T.) on Friday,
   February 26, 2027. There will be two draws: one on Friday November 27, 2026 and Friday,
   February 26, 2027. Your name will carry over for both draws, depending on when you entered,
   but you can only win once.
4. No purchase, expenditure or investment is necessary to enter this Contest.
5. Maximum of one Contest Entry per person. If more than one entry is received from a person,
   all such entries will be disqualified from the random draw.
6. The Region of Waterloo employees and their immediate families are not eligible for the
   Contest prizes.

Eligibility:
7. Entrants must be a resident of Ontario, Canada.

Prize Information:
8. Twenty $25 gift card prizes will be available to be won by eligible respondents. The prize to be
    drawn for is for:
        • A $25 gift card for your choice of either Tim Horton's, President's Choice, Sobey’s, Shoppers
            Drug Mart or Canadian Tire.
    The prize must be accepted as awarded and is non-refundable, non-transferable and non-
    redeemable for any cash value. The Region is not responsible for replacing the prize if it is lost,
    stolen, destroyed or used without your knowledge or consent.

Winner Selection:
9. The random draw for the prize will be conducted by one or more staff from the Plan and
    Budget Team.
10. The prize will be drawn from all completed submissions received during the Contest until the
    closing date set out in section 3 of these Rules and Regulations.
11. Each selected entrant will be notified by email by either November 20 or March 19 with the
    contact information provided with their entry.
12. The selected entrants must correctly answer a skill testing question posed by the Plan and
    Budget Team before being declared the winner.
13. In the event that the selected entrant incorrectly answers the skill testing question pursuant to
    item 14 above, or cannot be contacted pursuant to item 13 above, another entrant will be
    randomly selected for the applicable prize.
14. The Region's rulings on the winner are final and without appeal in all matters related to this
    Contest and the awarding of the prize.
15. In the event the selected entrant does not comply with these contest rules and regulations or
    cannot be contacted within 20 days of the draw, or declines the prize, an alternate entrant will
    be selected from the remaining entries.

    the prize will be forfeited, and shall waive any moral rights in relation to Submission.
19. The Region takes no responsibility for lost, misdirected, late, incomplete, illegible or destroyed

    Region reserves the right to seek remedies and damages to the fullest extent permitted by law,
    including criminal prosecution.
20. This Contest is subject to all federal, provincial and municipal laws.
21. Each entrant agrees to abide by all contest rules and will be deemed to have reviewed and
    understood the rules if they participate in this Contest.
22. The Region is not responsible for printing, distribution, or production errors and may terminate
    or withdraw this Contest at any time without prior notice.
